top_signals.title: Business confidence climbs on consumer spending power
top_signals.summary: Business confidence has risen to its highest level since March, as resilient consumers shrug off the impact of the Iran war and Budget-related speculation is kept to a minimum. top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
